disease_state: Skin prick test (SPT) solutions and allergy vaccines (AVs) are crucial tools for diagnosis and therapy of allergies.
material_type: SDS-PAGE, immunoblots and high-resolution mass spectrometric analysis was performed with 16 house dust mite (HDM) SPT solutions and AVs from 3 Indian manufacturers.
sample_source: Proteomic profiling of commercial dust mite skin prick test solutions and allergy vaccines from India☆
species: From the 5 Indian Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus products, none contained proteins from this source.
